mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the NPT's two biggest obstacles."
Disarmament and non-proliferation are the NPT's two biggest obstacles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used by politicians and diplomats to spread internal and worldwide propaganda."
Television is used by politicians and diplomats to spread internal and worldwide propaganda.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are one of the most efficient ways for countries to resolve disputes involving shared airspace and territorial boundaries."
International regimes are one of the most efficient ways for countries to resolve disputes involving shared airspace and territorial boundaries.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered transnational because the organization's formation, recruiting, training, planning, and attack all take place across international borders."
The terrorist organization's operations are considered transnational because the organization's formation, recruiting, training, planning, and attack all take place across international borders.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a development of the ideas outlined in the Magna Carta."
The English Bill of Rights is a development of the ideas outlined in the Magna Carta.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most serious threats to human survival in the post-cold war era."
Terrorism is one of the most serious threats to human survival in the post-cold war era.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only multilateral agreement that makes a legally binding commitment to the nuclear-weapon states' disarmament as a goal."
The Treaty is the only multilateral agreement that makes a legally binding commitment to the nuclear-weapon states' disarmament as a goal.
fib: ______ are a significant source of formal international law insofar as they are governed by agreements between nations.
Regimes are a significant source of formal international law insofar as they are governed by agreements between nations.
______ is the transfer of fissile material, nuclear weapons technology, or nuclear weapons to nations that do not already have them.
Nuclear proliferation is the transfer of fissile material, nuclear weapons technology, or nuclear weapons to nations that do not already have them.
______ is a dysfunctional and utilitarian weapon of government.
War is a dysfunctional and utilitarian weapon of government.
______ can be defined as a body of rules developed and used as a binding set of laws to facilitate relations between national governments.
International law can be defined as a body of rules developed and used as a binding set of laws to facilitate relations between national governments.
______ is a factor in how political power is distributed.
Today's globalisation is a factor in how political power is distributed.
______ are regarded as rational actors and will take every measure to sustain their survival.
States are regarded as rational actors and will take every measure to sustain their survival.
